excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content:
Running a local testnet with:
- Block Explorer
- Fork monitor
- Bootnode
- Consensus nodes: Prysm+Teku+Lighthouse
- Execution nodes: Geth+Nethermind+Besu

And would add Nimbus, but local testnet configuration there is still a problem, although they did great on Steklo devnet

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: There are two issues that slightly worry me for bluerider: Discovery and deposits. I feel that neither is being tested actively. Discovery is throwing some weird errors when using external enrs but works fine locally. Deposits are not being seen by prysm

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Before anyone asks; that genesis attestation performance dip seems mostly due to the nodes just getting peered on all subnets. The whole thing is fully automated, everything launches during a 60 second genesis delay 😂

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: <@!755590043632140352> Same, but we can't fix everything at the same time. I'd rather get some more tooling + eyes on specific unresolved issues, and then give it a second try. And with tooling I mean a working block explorer to browse blocks easily.
